summary: Runbook elevation session orphaned after IdP audience rotation between edge proxies
description:
Issue summary: Multiple oncall users report being unable to complete temporary runbook elevation flows. After approving elevation in the identity provider (Okta), the support console shows the runbook approval as pending and the user's temporary session is not attached to the elevated role. Impact: Oncall engineers cannot execute emergency runbooks for ~15% of elevation attempts in us-west region; blocking critical incident mitigation. Timeline: 2026-03-12 08:03 UTC first report from #oncall, 2026-03-12 08:10 SRE triage, 2026-03-12 09:00 reproduced in-house. Observed behaviour: SAML assertion from IdP has a rotated audience claim (auth-edge-2) while the identity-proxy expects auth-edge-1; the session-binding cookie is set for the proxy that does not match the runbook service's session aggregator, leaving an orphaned ephemeral token.

Important context: We rolled an IdP certificate rotation and passive audience update earlier in the morning (related change: PR #12345). Edge proxies are deployed in pairs; routing during the rotation caused some assertions to be signed with the new audience before the proxy routing table was fully updated.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger JIT elevation flow from support console as normal user
2) Approve elevation in Okta via the approval UI
3) Observe SAML assertion in network trace: audience claim set to auth-edge-2 while proxy aggregator uses auth-edge-1
4) Support console remains at 'Pending', runbook action buttons disabled, user does not receive elevated role claims
logs: 2026-03-12T08:09:23Z INFO identity-proxy[auth-edge-1]: received SAML assertion from idp-1, audience=auth-edge-2
2026-03-12T08:09:24Z WARN runbook-service: session-binding mismatch for session id=abcd1234, expected=auth-edge-1, got=auth-edge-2
2026-03-12T08:09:25Z ERROR support-console: elevation callback timeout waiting for session rebind (trace=/traces/xyz)
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: mis-synced audience configuration between IdP and edge proxy cluster after certificate/audience rotation
Confirmed by pulling SAML assertions from idp-rotate-host and comparing AudienceRestriction values: ~20% of assertions carried new audience before all proxies accepted it
Traffic routing analysis shows that LB sticky session keys routed some approval callbacks to auth-edge-2 while session aggregator state was still persisted under auth-edge-1
Reproduced locally by toggling idp audience header and forcing approval callback to different edge instance
comments: 2026-03-12 08:12 - Carlos Rivera: Acknowledged. I'm collecting proxy logs and tracing in #sre. Moving to In Progress.
2026-03-12 09:05 - Lina Patel (IAM): We deployed the audience rotation at 07:58 but the edge routing table had a delayed sync to a subset of nodes (see /confluence/runbooks/idp-rotation-runbook).
2026-03-12 09:20 - SRE (oncall): Mitigation Idea: force rebind of session aggregator or accept multiple audience values temporarily. Will try an aggregator restart on one canary node to validate fix.

2026-03-12 09:45 - Carlos Rivera: Performed controlled restart of session-aggregator on auth-edge-1 canary, verified previously-orphaned approvals processed and runbook elevated successfully for repro flow.
2026-03-13 14:30 - Security (Ana Gomez): Need confirmation that accepting multiple audiences won't widen attack surface. IAM to review and sign off on temporary policy change.

2026-03-14 10:00 - Carlos Rivera: Preparing PR to make audience validation tolerant for a short window and adding stricter audit logging. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/1289
workaround: 1) If you encounter a stuck elevation, ask the user to re-initiate the elevation flow after 60s; the next approval is routed to the updated session aggregator
2) SRE can perform a rolling restart of the session-aggregator on the affected edge node(s) to rebind orphaned sessions
3) As an emergency measure, IAM can temporarily add the new audience value to the accepted audiences list for the runbook service (requires Security sign-off)
resolution: Applied targeted restart of session-aggregator on 3 affected auth-edge nodes at 2026-03-12T11:02Z, orphaned approvals processed and cleared
Merged temporary audience-tolerance change in identity-proxy to accept previous+new audience for 1 hour window (PR #1289), deployed to us-west at 2026-03-14T10:15Z
Added audit logging to capture mismatched audience assertions and created an alert to detect >1% mismatches post-rotation
root_cause: IdP audience claim rotation was deployed before the edge proxy routing table and session aggregator state were fully synchronized, causing a subset of SAML assertions to carry an audience value not recognized by the aggregator, resulting in orphaned ephemeral elevation sessions.
follow_up_tasks: 1) Update IdP rotation runbook to include a pre-sync check and a paused approval window during audience rollout
2) Implement graceful audience fallback in identity-proxy with strict audit trail and TTL
3) Add automated check in deployment pipeline to verify audience values across all edge nodes before marking rotation complete
4) Postmortem to be drafted in Confluence and shared to #incidents and #security (owner: Maya Chen)
